title: Agent Frontmatter Schema
description: Valid frontmatter fields for Claude Code agent definitions

name.description: Agent identifier in kebab-case. Must match filename.

description.description: Short description with trigger keywords and NOT-for cases.

model.description: Model to use for agent execution.

color.description: Color for agent identification. See agent-color-taxonomy.md.

skills.description: Array of skill names this agent can use.

examples.name: development
examples.description: Implements Python modules with testing. Use for: write python, implement feature. NOT for: review code (code-quality), debug (debugger).
examples.tools: Read, Write, Edit, Grep, Glob, Bash

examples.name: researcher-codebase
examples.description: Searches and analyzes local codebase. Use for: find code, understand patterns. NOT for: modify files, run tests.

_meta.note: Any field not in properties is invalid. additionalProperties: false enforces this.
